text.title: SEO Techniques Procedure
text.summary: 5-step procedure to apply the SEO Techniques methodology end-to-end, plus three technique-level sub-procedures: schema validation workflow, AI-friendly content structure check, pillar-cluster linking build.

step.name: check-preconditions
step.input: The "Applies If" + "Skip If" lists from AGENTS.md.
step.action: Verify every Applies-If item holds AND no Skip-If item triggers.
step.output: Boolean: methodology applies / does not apply.
step.decision-gate: If preconditions fail, emit a skip-record naming the failed precondition and STOP.

step.name: gather-inputs
step.action: Read each input; attach its path/URL to the working artefact. Refuse to proceed if any input is unreachable.

step.name: apply-rules
step.input: Inputs gathered + the rules from content/01-core-rules.xml.
step.action: Walk each rule; record per-rule pass/fail; capture the violating snippet on any fail.
step.decision-gate: If any HARD rule fails, repair the artefact or escalate; do not return a partially-conformant output.

step.name: produce-artefact
step.action: Fill the template under `templates/` according to the schema in content/02-output-contract.xml.

step.name: validate-and-handover
step.action: Run `scripts/validate-seo-techniques.py --file <path>`. Fix any reported violations. Send to named owner.
step.output: Owner-signed artefact registered with the consumer.

step.name: schema-validation-workflow
step.action:
Run the validation workflow in order before any deployment:
1. Generate schema from template or agent
2. Validate JSON syntax (jsonlint.com or IDE linter)
3. Test with Google Rich Results Test
4. Verify no conflicting schema definitions on the same page
5. Deploy and monitor Search Console for schema errors
step.output: Validated schema deployed; Search Console monitored.
step.decision-gate: If Rich Results Test reports an error, do not deploy; fix and re-test.

step.name: ai-friendly-content-check
step.input: Page draft + entity rules r3-create-a-llms and r4-use-the-exact.
step.action:
Check the content structure for AI citation:
Clear entity definitions in the first paragraph of each page
Consistent entity naming throughout (no pronoun substitution for first mention)
Statistics attributed to named sources with publication date
Dates on all time-sensitive content (datePublished, dateModified in schema)
Author credentials visible near the article (name, role, expertise signal)
step.output: Page passes every structure check or lists the failing items.

step.name: pillar-cluster-linking
step.action:
Build the pillar-cluster structure:
Identify 5-10 pillar topics (comprehensive guides on broad subjects)
Create cluster pages (specific subtopics within each pillar)
Pillar links to all cluster pages with keyword-rich anchor text
Cluster pages link back to pillar with target keyword anchor
No orphan pages — every page has at least one internal link pointing to it
Maximum 3 clicks from homepage to any page
step.output: Pillar/cluster map with bidirectional links; zero orphan pages.
step.decision-gate: If any page is more than 3 clicks from the homepage or has no inbound internal link, add links before publishing.
